dataset.title: LIDAR DSM Time Stamped Tiles

local_use: Local OpenCode intersects canonical building-bearing parcels/AOI with the DSM extent polygons, selects matching DSM and DTM official tiles, then computes parcel min/max/mean/max-min. No such parcel computation is performed here.
limitations: Source-area evidence only; not an accepted Layer24 parcel record.
